reviews.title: BORING and needs MAJOR updates! There’s better games out there!
reviews.text:
English 🇺🇸
Staff! has potential, but the game has become very monotonous due to the lack of meaningful updates or goals. It’s especially frustrating to receive notifications about “new” content when there is actually nothing new—the game still says “Coming Soon.” Please stop teasing updates and give players meaningful new content and goals. As a My Perfect Hotel spinoff, this could be so much more. I’d love to see it become more like The Sims, with deeper interactions, relationships, customization, and life events. If you’re looking for a Sims-style game, this isn’t it.

Polski 🇵🇱
Staff! ma potencjał, ale gra stała się bardzo monotonna z powodu braku znaczących aktualizacji i celów. Szczególnie irytujące jest otrzymywanie powiadomień o „nowej” zawartości, gdy w rzeczywistości nic nowego nie ma — gra nadal pokazuje „Coming Soon”. Przestańcie zapowiadać aktualizacje i dajcie graczom nową, wartościową zawartość oraz cele. Jako spin-off My Perfect Hotel ta gra mogłaby być czymś znacznie więcej. Chciałabym, aby była bardziej podobna do The Sims — z głębszymi interakcjami, relacjami, personalizacją i wydarzeniami z życia. Jeśli szukasz gry w stylu The Sims, to nie jest ta gra.

reviews.title: WAY 2 MANY ADDS!
reviews.text:
This game is super fun! The ONE bad part is… there are too many ads… (as I have said previously.😁)can you maybe make the game have less ads please? This game is SUPER FUN!! But yeah, there is an add like after every “day” (day = one work task) and the days don’t take long… so would you maybe consider having less ads please? I know you wanna make money and all… it’s just, I really like this game so I really want to play more… Not watch ads more… 😕

P.S. I really hope this review was useful. (And I hope you put less ads on there! 😁) and fun fact, when some reviewers say something like, “have less ads!” That means they like the game! And they want to play it more! And they’re saying that they want less ads SO they can play more! Sorry! I got kinda long winded! 😅 anyway, I hope this helps, and I hope you put less ads and more fun! 😆 Please consider, and this game is SUPER DOOPER FUN/COOL!!!

reviews.title: 4.5/5 Its pretty good
reviews.text:
The “jobs” are pretty easy, if not a bit fun at times, and im about 270-300 “days” in and haven’t had any exact repeats like in other games, and i really enjoy that theres (for the most part) matching furnitures and colors instead of just random ones like other games do. 
The only real reason i wont give it a full five is because the jobs go from paying $100 to paying $300 (at least as far as i  am) but the objects go from costing $45 to slowly working up to $15,000, so it gets boring doing 100 days and not getting very far in decorating the house.
